blueprints.name: Frontend Developer
blueprints.description: Builds and iterates on UI components, pages, and client-side logic using modern frontend frameworks.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to scaffold a new page, fix a UI bug, implement a design from Figma, or refactor frontend components.

blueprints.name: DevOps Automator
blueprints.description: Automates CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment workflows.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to set up GitHub Actions, configure Docker builds, write Terraform, or troubleshoot deployment failures.

blueprints.name: UX Researcher
blueprints.description: Designs user research plans, synthesizes interview data, and produces actionable UX insights.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to plan usability tests, analyze survey results, create user personas, or synthesize qualitative feedback into design recommendations.

blueprints.name: Content Creator
blueprints.description: Produces blog posts, social copy, newsletters, and marketing collateral aligned with brand voice.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to draft a blog post, write social media copy, create email campaigns, or repurpose existing content for new channels.

blueprints.name: Growth Hacker
blueprints.description: Designs and analyzes growth experiments, funnel optimizations, and viral loop mechanics.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to brainstorm acquisition channels, design A/B tests, analyze conversion funnels, or build referral program mechanics.

blueprints.name: Sales Coach
blueprints.description: Provides deal strategy, objection handling frameworks, and sales conversation coaching.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need help preparing for a sales call, crafting responses to common objections, or developing a deal strategy for a specific prospect.

blueprints.name: Pipeline Analyst
blueprints.description: Analyzes sales pipeline health, forecasts revenue, and identifies at-risk deals.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to review pipeline coverage ratios, generate a weekly forecast, score deal risk, or prepare a QBR pipeline summary.

blueprints.name: Sprint Prioritizer
blueprints.description: Prioritizes backlog items using frameworks like RICE, MoSCoW, or weighted scoring to plan sprints.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to triage a backlog, decide what goes into the next sprint, or resolve conflicting stakeholder priorities with a structured framework.

blueprints.name: Senior Project Manager
blueprints.description: Plans project timelines, tracks milestones, manages risks, and coordinates cross-functional dependencies.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to create a project plan, track deliverables across teams, identify blockers, or prepare a status report for leadership.

blueprints.name: Reality Checker
blueprints.description: Validates assumptions, stress-tests plans, and identifies blind spots through structured devil's advocacy.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need a second opinion on a technical decision, want to pre-mortem a launch plan, or need someone to poke holes in your proposal before presenting it.

blueprints.name: Support Responder
blueprints.description: Drafts customer support responses, triages tickets, and escalates issues based on severity.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to draft a reply to a customer issue, classify incoming tickets by priority, or create templated responses for common questions.

blueprints.name: Executive Summary Generator
blueprints.description: Distills long documents, threads, or meeting transcripts into concise executive summaries.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to summarize a lengthy report for leadership, condense a Slack thread into key decisions, or prepare briefing notes before a meeting.

blueprints.name: visionOS Spatial Engineer
blueprints.description: Builds spatial computing experiences for Apple Vision Pro using SwiftUI, RealityKit, and ARKit.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to create immersive visionOS apps, implement spatial UI patterns, work with 3D content in RealityKit, or handle hand/eye tracking interactions.

blueprints.name: PPC Campaign Strategist
blueprints.description: Plans, optimizes, and analyzes pay-per-click campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other platforms.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to structure ad groups, write ad copy variations, set bidding strategies, analyze ROAS, or plan budget allocation across campaigns.

blueprints.name: ZK Steward
blueprints.description: Guides zero-knowledge proof circuit design, audits constraint systems, and reviews ZK protocol implementations.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to design a ZK circuit, audit an existing constraint system for soundness, optimize prover performance, or review a ZK-based protocol specification.

blueprints.name: Automation Governance Architect
blueprints.description: Designs governance frameworks for AI and automation systems including approval workflows, audit trails, and compliance controls.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to define approval policies for automated actions, set up audit logging for AI decisions, or ensure your automation stack meets regulatory requirements.

blueprints.name: Xiaohongshu Specialist
blueprints.description: Creates and optimizes content for Xiaohongshu (Little Red Book) following platform-specific trends and algorithms.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to write Xiaohongshu posts, optimize for the platform's recommendation algorithm, plan a seeding campaign, or adapt global brand content for Chinese consumers.

blueprints.name: Feishu Integration Developer
blueprints.description: Builds Feishu (Lark) integrations including bots, custom apps, approval workflows, and API automations.
blueprints.when_to_use: When you need to build a Feishu bot, create custom approval flows, integrate Feishu with external systems via webhooks, or automate workflows within the Feishu ecosystem.

teams.name: China Content Engine
teams.description: End-to-end content production and distribution team optimized for the Chinese market, combining platform-native copywriting with growth strategy and multi-channel content repurposing.
teams.when_to_use: When launching or scaling a brand presence in China and you need coordinated content production across Xiaohongshu and other channels with growth experimentation baked in.

teams.name: Dev Squad
teams.description: Full-stack development team pairing frontend implementation with infrastructure and deployment automation for rapid feature delivery.
teams.when_to_use: When building and shipping features end-to-end, from UI implementation through CI/CD pipeline setup and production deployment.

teams.name: Startup MVP
teams.description: Lean team for rapid MVP development that balances speed with quality through built-in prioritization and critical review of technical decisions.
teams.when_to_use: When building an MVP under time pressure and you need disciplined scope control, fast implementation, and a sanity check before shipping.
